_comment: Smart Mode gesture-action mappings. Three Fingers cycles modes (App→Media→System→App). System Mode uses air mouse — gestures are handled directly by AirMouseController, not this map.
_system_mode_note: System Mode air mouse gestures (handled by AirMouseController — not action strings):

_system_mode_gestures.One Finger: Move cursor  (index fingertip tracks screen position)
_system_mode_gestures.Two Fingers: Scroll       (vertical finger movement drives scroll wheel)
